title: Extract maxChanges arg-parser into jmap-server, reduce 7-crate duplication
description:
**Pattern source**: bd:JMAP-826m.21 noted that jmap-metadata-server's handle_metadata_changes duplicates the canonical jmap-server::handle_changes maxChanges parsing logic. The duplication exists because handle_metadata_changes does its own arg-parsing pass to extract Metadata-specific filter args (filterRelatedType, filterMetadataType) before delegating, and that pass needs maxChanges too.

**Current duplication**:
- jmap-server/src/handlers.rs:176-181 — canonical maxChanges parser in handle_changes.
- jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs (around line 130) — copy: 'maxChanges: Option<u64> = match args.get("maxChanges")... filter(|&n| n > 0)'.

Other extension-server crates with custom /changes handlers (whichever ones do pre-delegate filter validation) likely have the same duplication. Confirmed at least in jmap-metadata-server; needs sibling audit.

**Fix shape**: extract pub fn parse_max_changes(args: &Map<String,Value>) -> Result<Option<u64>, JmapError> into jmap-server::helpers or handlers. Use from both jmap-server::handle_changes AND from extension-server pre-delegate paths.

**Workspace canonical rule**: per AGENTS.md, changes to jmap-server (foundation) ripple through every consumer. Plan the downstream propagation in the same pass.

**Out of scope**: changing the semantic of maxChanges=0 (the bead title was misleading — '0 is silently None' is not the actual bug; the code DOES reject 0 with invalidArguments. The bug is code duplication, not semantic ambiguity.)

**Acceptance**:
- jmap-server exposes a single pub parser.
- jmap-metadata-server uses the shared parser.
- Audit of all other *-server crates: if they have a custom /changes handler with pre-delegate parsing, switch to the shared parser.
- Regression test in jmap-server locks in the maxChanges=0 → invalidArguments behavior so the shared parser cannot regress.

Filed as P2 because the actual divergence risk (jmap-server changes maxChanges parsing without metadata-server following) is low — no maxChanges-shape changes are likely without a workspace-wide review pass.
